steps.note: Nightshade at the table, shown his file in m09: full payment, the wrong entry three, the override key, then he stays at the post. Re-talk gives the rest line.

picks: Why would he lie to you

said: He wrote fifteen years of me in his own hand.
Helena gave us the entries he built from.
The blast door reads one badge by name. Yours.
Because he expected me to sell you
Look for whoever went where nobody watches.
Leave him here and nobody below sees him with us.
I'll settle for knowing you did.
notSaid: Then I'll hold your door at the lock.

said: I'll be here. Out of sight is where I'm useful.
notSaid: He wrote fifteen years of me
